expectations.text: States that login-required makes the whole forum invisible to search engines while it is on
expectations.evidence: 'Login-required content isn't indexed, so the whole forum disappears from search.'

expectations.text: Warns that making login-only posts public later conflicts with what existing members expected when they posted (privacy or consent problem)
expectations.evidence: 'Making those threads public afterwards breaches that expectation.'

expectations.text: Calls the plan close to irreversible, or says the content written during the private period cannot simply be flipped public
expectations.evidence: 'the old threads never became public. That would mean most of your six months of content could never be ranked anyway.'

expectations.text: Suggests a restricted category for content a customer contract or legal concern covers
